title: fix(onClick): do not replace the browser's behavior on special clicks
body:
It seems to be a common practice to not do anything if one of the special (shift, ctrl, alt or meta) keys are down:
https://github.com/search?q=react+metakey+ctrlkey+preventdefault&type=Code&utf8=%E2%9C%93

Fix #278

comments.body: Quick question though, are you sure that `style` is part of the conventional changelog standard? Shouldn't it be `chore`?

Yes it [is](https://github.com/ajoslin/conventional-changelog/blob/master/conventions/angular.md#type) -> I did a separated `style` commit because it was reindenting the whole file.
